abstract.t: This document specifies the Offline Emergency Peer-to-Peer Broadcast Protocol (OEPB), an experimental protocol for disseminating authenticated emergency alerts among unprovisioned devices over short-range peer-to-peer radios when network infrastructure is unavailable. OEPB defines a compact 256-byte packet format with Ed25519 signatures; a transport abstraction over radios such as Bluetooth Low Energy, Wi-Fi Direct, and LoRa; per-message Trickle dissemination with a bounded number of retransmissions; a five-class weighted fair queuing scheme reflecting emergency triage priorities; and a trust model in which relays forward without verifying signatures, so that unauthenticated distress messages still propagate while receivers authenticate authority alerts. A companion document defines the Bluetooth Low Energy transport binding.
